rulesIfApplicable: Camping only at designated/anvisad place near the old farmstead.

dogs.notes: Härryda rules require dogs leashed near exercise tracks, always in nature reserves, and in forest/land from 1 March to 20 August; otherwise very close control is required. Keep dogs leashed near farms, livestock and the Hestrafors/Hestra settlement edge.

winterAndSkiTracks.notes: A 2025-02-16 AllTrails review reports the first part was closed because of ski tracks. Hindås SK confirms active winter ski operations and track restrictions in the Hindås/Hindåsgården area. Treat the first kilometres as seasonally sensitive until official walking-route winter status is confirmed.

terrainAndAccessibility.notes: Official sources describe forest, small paths and forest roads with hilly terrain and some fairly steep sections. Borås Stad states the trail is not accessibility-adapted. AllTrails describes 424 m ascent and a 13.8 km point-to-point route.

huntingForestryLivestock.notes: No current Etapp 1-specific hunting or forestry closure was found. Apply generic Swedish trail caution in autumn/winter hunting periods and near active forestry, farms, livestock and gates.

conditionReports.importImpact: Older support for marking caution and hilly terrain around Hestrafors/Hestra.

conditionReports.summary: E1 guide introduction lists Knalleleden from Hindås to Borås as hiked in March 2014 and separately identifies Sjuhäradsleden/Redvägsleden onward; a detailed Knalleleden section page was not found in this pass.
conditionReports.importImpact: Alias/E1 context only; do not use for facility or geometry decisions.

conditionReports.summary: Vildmarksleden guide notes the E1 continues from Hindås on Knalleleden toward Borås and mentions train access at Hindås.
conditionReports.importImpact: Useful context for the Hindås E1 handoff and legacy Knalleleden naming, not section-specific facility evidence.

sourceContradictions.details: Official municipal/tourism pages state 13 km; Naturkartan says 13.6 km and computes to 13.611 km; OSM computes around 13.657 km; AllTrails reports 13.8 km; Wikiloc user track is about 14.44 km.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use official 13 km for planning display and GPX-derived distance for geometry metadata.

sourceContradictions.details: Västsverige/Härryda says Etapp 1 starts at Hindås station, but also says Sjuhäradsleden begins at Hindåsgården. Official map and GPX support a Hindås station stage start with route passing Hindåsgården.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use Hindås station as section endpoint; treat Hindåsgården/Hjortviken as route-area service/POI.

sourceContradictions.details: Official section label says Hestrafors IF, OSM relation says to=Brandshed, and the Naturkartan/OSM route endpoint is about 350-400 m south of Borås's Hestrafors IF/Bollevi coordinate.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not snap the route end to the clubhouse. Model route endpoint and access cluster separately until trail manager confirms intended endpoint geometry.

sourceContradictions.details: Borås describes the trail generally as well signposted, while Naturkartan warns the whole trail is not fully quality-assured and field reports include both good-marking and weak-marking experiences.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Keep a visible currentness/signage caveat in the research handoff.

sourceContradictions.details: Official descriptions emphasize forest, small paths and forest roads. Recent AllTrails reviews complain that much of the stage is asphalt/gravel/transport-like.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: App copy should not overpromise a wild singletrack experience; include mixed forest roads/small paths and possible road/gravel character.

sourceContradictions.details: Official pages/map legend show access symbols, but no official source confirms stage-specific toilet, shelter or water facilities on Etapp 1. OSM/Naturkartan third-party objects identify several nearby candidates.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Import only individually verified facility objects; keep clubhouse/commercial/private services as access or pending metadata.

sourceContradictions.details: Klippan naturreservat is near the Hindås trail network and has strict rules, but exact overlap with Etapp 1 GPX was not confirmed.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not apply reserve rules as full-stage rules until GIS overlay confirms whether the route enters the reserve.

sourceContradictions.details: A 2025 AllTrails review reports the first part was closed due to ski tracks. Hindås SK has active ski operations, but no official walking-route winter closure notice for Etapp 1 was found.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Keep as seasonal caution requiring official confirmation.

sourceContradictions.details: Official Sjuhäradsleden order and Naturkartan GPX are Hindås to Hestrafors IF; E1 Hiking Europe presents the same geometry in reverse as Hestrafors IF to Hindås.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use official Sjuhäradsleden direction for section order and route display.

researchIterations.scope: Whole-trail overview and initial section inventory
researchIterations.summary: Established official trail identity, 10-stage order, Naturkartan GPX availability, OSM relation inventory and overview caveats before section-level research.
Confirmed official endpoints, distance/time/difficulty, source URLs, access notes and official caveats.
Audited Naturkartan GPX, OSM relation 5604821, Waymarked Trails, E1 reverse GPX and route endpoint discrepancies.
Collected facility candidates around Hindås, Hindåsgården, route corridor, Hestrafors IF/Bollevi and nearby detours; assigned import/pending/suppress/access decisions.
Established Hindås station as strong start access and Holmens bro/limited Västtrafik preordered traffic as weak end transit access; collected parking notes.
Collected AllTrails 2025 condition reports, Wikiloc/user-track clues and older runner/E1 blog reports on marking, terrain, water and winter ski-track issues.
Collected currentness warnings, fire-ban source policy, dog rules, Klippan reserve conditional rules, winter ski-track caveat and generic safety notes.
Merged lane findings into this section research JSON and marked section ready for normalization with caveats, not runtime import.

openQuestions.question: Is the first Hindås/Hindåsgården section officially closed or rerouted during prepared ski-track periods?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Affects seasonal availability and route instructions.

openQuestions.question: Can the public drinking-water tap near Hindås station be confirmed as currently operating and seasonal/all-year?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Determines whether it can be imported as reliable potable water.

openQuestions.question: Are toilets at Västra Nedsjön, Hindås station, Hjortviken, Hindås Camping or Hestrafors IF publicly available to hikers and in what season?

openQuestions.whyItMatters: Affects import confidence and currentness warnings.

importReadiness.summary: Section 1 has enough official source, GPX/OSM geometry, commute, facilities, rules and field-report evidence for a normalization pass. It is not ready for direct runtime import because endpoint/access semantics, reserve overlap, winter ski-track seasonality and several facility currentness questions remain.
importReadiness.recommendedGeometry: Use Naturkartan Etapp 1 GPX as primary geometry in official Hindås-to-Hestrafors direction; use OSM relation 5604821 as cross-check.
importReadiness.recommendedEndpointPolicy: Use GPX endpoints for route geometry. Model Hestrafors IF/Bollevi as the end access cluster about 350-400 m north of the route-line endpoint.
recommendedFacilityPolicy: Import Hindås potable tap, ICA Nära Hindås, Västra Nedsjön badplats components, Hjortviken commercial services, Hindås restaurants and Petaredbackens picnic shelter only after source/currentness review.
Keep Hindås Camping, Hulta GK, Klippan objects, Hindås Kanotklubb, Ballasjön and Bollebygd centre as pending/off-route metadata unless integration scope includes them.
Suppress transit shelters as hiking shelters and suppress unnamed far-off viewpoint.
majorCaveats: Naturkartan trail-wide QA warning remains active.
Hestrafors IF official label and GPX/OSM route endpoint do not coincide.
Winter ski-track conflict near Hindås/Hindåsgården unresolved.
End transit access is weak and uses limited/preordered service.
importReadiness.nextSafeStep: Resume with section 2 six-agent batch in a new thread/worktree, keeping this section unchanged unless a coordinator intentionally revisits the open questions.
